title: NeuroLearn AI - Multi-Tenant Firestore Schema Blueprint
description: Comprehensive document schema schemas for school-level data isolation, role-based controls, and row-level security partitions.

users.description: Primary user profiles mapping system clearances and active school tenancy identifiers.
users.rowLevelSecurity: Authenticated owner or Super Admin, or School Admin of the same tenant

id.description: Equal to the Firebase Auth uid.

name.description: Display name of the student, instructor, or administrator.

tenantId.description: School Tenant Partition Key (e.g. stanford_univ, mit_eng).

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds representing creation time.

lastActive.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds representing last operational handshake.

tenants.description: Core institutional boundaries providing custom branding and system budget variables.
tenants.rowLevelSecurity: Super Admin or users belonging to the specific tenant partition

decks.description: Flashcard learning decks partitioned strictly by tenantId to enforce school data boundaries.
decks.rowLevelSecurity: Authenticated users of the matching tenant. Modifications restricted to owners, teachers, or administrators.

tenantId.description: The school partition ID matching creator's school.

cards.description: Individual flashcard items located inside a deck. Inherits tenant boundaries from the parent document.

audit_logs.description: Immutable, tamper-proof system audit logs hashed and partitioned sequentially.
audit_logs.rowLevelSecurity: Super Admin read access. School Admin of the matching tenant can read tenant-specific logs. Write-only for users, updates/deletions blocked completely.

action.description: Action category, e.g., AUTH_SIGN_IN, KEY_ROTATION, SYNC_MERGE.

details.description: Expanded description of the event details.

sha256ChainHash.description: SHA-256 hash chaining this block to the previous audit log block.

talent_profiles.description: Verified student portfolios containing certified skills available to institutional recruiters.
talent_profiles.rowLevelSecurity: Student owner has write access. Recruiters, matching students, and admins have read access.

analytics_metrics.description: Operational diagnostics tracking system safety, crash logs, and school telemetry.
analytics_metrics.rowLevelSecurity: Super Admin and School Admin of matching tenant

featureUsageMap.description: Keys mapping feature name to usage counts.

recommendedIndexes.description: Enables fast user-specific deck sorting and display dashboards.
Enables tenant-isolated listings and chronological admin reviews.
Allows school administrators to view historical logs sequentially within their school partition.
